title: Hallowing Flame
wikitext:
{{status |name = Hallowing Flame |type = Debuff |bonuses = Attack Hits against you gain 25% of Physical Damage as Extra Fire Damage |description = The next attack hit against you will gain a portion of physical damage as extra fire. }} '''Hallowing Flame''' is a [[debuff]] that causes an [[attack]] [[hit]] against the affected target to gain 25% of [[physical]] damage [[damage conversion|as extra]] [[fire damage]]. Hallowing Flame cannot benefit the entity that inflicted it. ==Mechanics== {{c|help|Attacks made against Enemies affected by Hallowing Flame gain 25% of Physical Damage as Extra Fire Damage.}}
{{c|help|Hallowing Flame is removed once an Attack that benefits from this Damage as Extra is successfully made.}}
{{c|help|Hallowing Flame lasts for six seconds and cannot benefit the one who inflicted it.}} Hallowing Flame causes an incoming attack hit to gain extra fire damage, after which the debuff is removed. The hit cannot be from the debuff's source, requiring the involvement of [[minion]]s, [[proxies]], or other [[allies]]. The debuff lasts up to 6 seconds. Visually, affected targets are orbited by a fiery wisp (per stack). Hallowing Flame cannot normally stack, but an additional stack may be applied with [[Guardian]]'s [[Marshal of Divinity]], for a total of two, or {{c|mod|50% of Physical Damage as Extra Fire Damage}}. Hits that remove Hallowing Flame remove all existing stacks of the debuff. They can still inflict a new Hallowing Flame debuff afterward. [[Proxies]] can inflict Hallowing Flame, and can benefit from Hallowing Flame from other proxies. A proxy cannot benefit from its own Hallowing Flame. ==Sources== ===Support gems=== {{Query stat related skill gems |type=support |stat_id_query=%hallowing_flame% |stat_page=Hallowing Flame }} ===Unique items=== The table below lists [[unique items]] that are related to Hallowing Flame: {{Item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.rarity = "unique" AND item_stats.id like "%Hallowing Flame%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Hallowing Flame%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related passive skills== The table below displays [[passive skills]] related to Hallowing Flame. ===Cluster Jewel passive skills=== The following [[Cluster Jewel]] [[passive skill]]s are related to Hallowing Flame: {{Passive skill table |q_where=passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Hallowing Flame%" |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ===Ascendancy passive skills=== The following [[Ascendancy passive skill]]s are related to Hallowing Flame: {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Hallowing Flame%" }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.28.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} [[Category:Debuffs]]
